collect_env_info: run collect_env to gather CUDA, GPU, PyTorch, and compiler environment details into a dictionary
collect_env_gpu_devices: run collect_env to list all available GPU devices and their names on the system
collect_env_cuda_home: run collect_env to retrieve the CUDA_HOME path and NVCC compiler version information
collect_env_pytorch_details: run collect_env to get PyTorch version, compiling details, and TorchVision version info
get_cuda_home_path: call _get_cuda_home to retrieve the CUDA or ROCM home directory path from PyTorch
